scope: All eleven tedy/teda connectives in paper 45.
choice: Normalize all eleven to established type-1 result marker zato.
motivation: Each site is an explicit mathematical conclusion or result transition; none is temporal, conditional-apodotic, or appositive. EDIT-0044 already binds zato for this exact semantic function and rejects branch-weighted teda/tedy.
alternatives_rejected: Retain the West-shaped connective layer: leaves an unnecessary branch-specific duplicate.
Use togda: falsely introduces temporal or conditional meaning.
Use imenno: falsely turns conclusions into namely/appositive explanations.

evidence.context_review: Exact paper-45 lines 308, 442, 460, 466, 483, 518, 544, 549, 551, 558, and 575 are all conclusion/result transitions.
evidence.binding_precedent: ISV019-EDIT-0044 established official type-1 zato for genuine inference/result markers.

validation.residue: zero whole-token tedy/teda remains in paper 45
validation.structure: TeX controls, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: Frozen output hash reproduced immediately before atomic apply
